title: 7.3 She's wearing a blue dress
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Say what people are wearing now with am/is/are + wearing (Luis is wearing a black jacket.) and ask What are you wearing?.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.3 My Clothes: A1 names clothes and their colors (My shirt is red.); A1+ 7.3 says what someone is wearing now. The one new grammar relationship is am/is/are + wearing + clothes (Luis is wearing a black jacket. / I'm wearing a red shirt.), with the question What are you wearing? / What is she wearing?. It uses A1+ 3.3's he's/she's + -ing. Four new photos dress the cast in one clear piece each, and A1's photos of a red hat, a hat and shorts, boots and a red scarf come back.
prerequisite: A1 7.3 clothes and colors; A1 7.5 boots, scarf and shorts; A1+ 3.3 he's/she's + -ing.
speaking_outcome: Say wearing as WAIR-ing with the stress on the first part, and join I'm wearing (aim-WAIR-ing). Do not require native-like speed.
